visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a dark blue t-shirt and grey shorts stands in a room with a brown door and white cabinets, displaying his abdomen. He flexes his arms to show muscle definition. A vertical split-screen then appears, showing shirtless 'Before' and 'After' photos of him highlighting significant weight loss and muscle gain over six months. (2) The scene shifts to the man sitting beside a woman with reddish hair in a brightly lit indoor space. She points towards him while talking. The man touches his chin and face. Graphic icons and checkmarks appear next to them, indicating physical improvements. (3) A macro close-up of the man's nose reveals skin pores and blackheads. A white bottle of facial cleanser is shown being held by a hand. The man and woman are seen in a bathroom setting, applying white foam to their faces and massaging their skin. (4) The woman demonstrates the application of several skincare products including a liquid toner and a thicker cream. She shows the textures on her hands and wipes her face with a cotton pad. Split-screen shots compare the man's facial skin before and after a 7-day period. (5) Footage transitions to a industrial/laboratory setting. A person in white gloves opens a frosted freezer door revealing rows of samples. A Korean certificate of patent is displayed on screen, followed by shots of laboratory equipment extracting liquids from plant-like materials. (6) The woman returns to the screen, holding four white bottles. She smiles and gestures toward the camera as promotional pricing and a 'Buy 4 Get 1' text overlay appear on the screen.
